name: Spin for PLEASURE
source:
You are a Contestant on a Game Show which promises to make you feel good the more you play.  Your choices will judge what happens to you, and the future of the Game Show.

[From [url=https://cattrigger.itch.io/spin-for-pleasure]itch.io[/url]]
